name: Kohinata Hibiki
source:
Hobbies: Skateboarding and exciting things.
Favorite foods: Apples and pancakes.

"As of now, you're amid happiness, pushing toward a happy road."

She is a 2nd year at Kazami Academy and a part of the Active Club. She is Yuu's childhood friend.
After returning to Kazami City after a few years, she reunites with him.

She is cheerful, sociable, and a beauty moreover, and she immediately became the center of attention in class.
For the time being, she wants to do something interesting. 

After transferring to the academy with the feeling of spending her school life in enjoyment with everybody, she starts a club called "Action Club", also known as the "Active Club".

[Translated from [url=http://sagaplanets.product.co.jp/works/kakenuke/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
